service.description: Implements standard MCP tools/list by scanning all active components for service definitions located in standard Moqui service directories under service/**/mcp/** and transforming in-parameters into JSON Schema parameter definitions.

parameter.name: domain
parameter.description: Optional filter by tool domain/verb category

parameter.name: targetComponent
parameter.description: Optional filter by component name (e.g. agi-ide, nursinghome)

parameter.name: tools
parameter.description: List of MCP Tool definitions with JSON Schema input definitions

service.description: Executes a dynamically discovered MCP tool by resolving its component, schema definition, and fully qualified Moqui service call path.

parameter.name: arguments
parameter.description: The argument map adhering to the tool's inputSchema
